values.note: Electric $20 walk-in, $23 reserved Creekside; Lakeside full hookup $30; non-electric $15. Reservations carry a small added fee, up to 5 people (more $5).

fees.source: https://www.buchanancounty.iowa.gov/services/conservation/buchanan_county_campgrounds_and_cabins.php ('$20/night w/ electricity; $23/night for reserved sites; $15/night w/o electricity'; 'A small fee is assessed by the reservation site') + mycountyparks Site L04 ('$30 per night with electricity, water, and sewer'), read 2026-11-02

hookups.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/county/buchanan/Park/Fontana-Park/Facility/Fontana-Park-Lakeside-Site-L04 ('50, 30, and 20-amp electricity, water, and sewer hookups'), read 2026-11-02

facilities.source: https://www.buchanancounty.iowa.gov/services/conservation/buchanan_county_campgrounds_and_cabins.php ('its own shower house with flush toilets, and a dump station') + Site L04 ('Pressurized water'), read 2026-11-02

values.note: May change. After October 1 sites stay available first come through much of the fall, without water or the showerhouse; closed in winter.

season.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/county/buchanan/Park/Fontana-Park ('The camping season runs from April 15th to October 1st but may be subject to change') + Site C02 ('After October 1 campsites are not reservable, but still are available on a first come basis through much of the fall season. Water and showerhouse will not be available until April 15'; 'The camping area is not open during the winter season'), read 2026-11-02

values.note: Reservable online: Lakeside L02-L16, Creekside C01-C07. Unreserved sites go first come. Check-in after 3 PM, check-out before 3 PM.

booking.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/county/buchanan/Park/Fontana-Park/Facility/Fontana-Park-Lakeside-Site-L04 ('Sites are reservable April 15 - October 1'; 'Sites that are not reserved are available on a first-come basis'; 'Reservations must be made 3 days in advance'; 'Check-in is after 03:00 PM and check-out is before 03:00 PM'), read 2026-11-02

note: Buchanan County Conservation park S of Hazleton, the county's most popular campground, on Fontana Lake (Otter Creek reservoir). A Lakeside campground on the bench east of the lake and a Creekside campground in pines below the dam. Nature center and live animal display within walking distance. --Claude
summary: Fees $30/$30 -> $20/$30; water + sewer added at Lakeside; season Apr 15-Oct 1; booking some_sites, 3 days ahead. Lakefront -> lakeview lead; pin is in the lake.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD: stored lakefront fails on the county's own Lakeside Campground map (https://content.mycountyparks.com/Production/RelatedItem/Content/bd65d0b6-0e40-441c-8de9-b38ef42231a7). Between the nearest row (L01-L08) and Fontana Lake lie a prairie strip, the two-way park road and a trail, then shoreline, roughly 50-80 m by my reading of the map against imagery. AWH's rule (land between open with no driveways) blocks on-water, so lakeview for the L01-L08 row, and only if the lake actually shows across the prairie, which I could not confirm. Rows L09-L26 are further back. Creekside (C01-C07) is in a pine plantation below the dam with two lanes between it and the creek. Esri imagery here predates the Lakeside campground (shows an empty field), so distances are from the map, not from pads on imagery. Unsure, so down.

PIN off: stored 42.60530,-91.90980 sits in the lake itself. Corrected about 42.6064,-91.9090 (mid Lakeside), read from the county map aligned to the park road and shop buildings; no pads visible on the Esri tile, so this is map-derived, not an imagery pin. Creekside is south of 125th St below the dam, roughly 500-700 m from Lakeside (estimated, not measured on pads): under the ~1 km split threshold, so no split proposed.

Fee low: I used $20 electric, not $15 non-electric, because no page says the non-electric sites fit a 23-ft motorhome. The stored note's 'all sites electric' is wrong against the county's $15 w/o electricity rate; dropped.

Site count left unset: Lakeside map shows L01-L26, seven reservable at Creekside, the first-come Creekside count isn't stated. Pads: Lakeside L04 75-ft gravel back-in; Creekside 65 x 10 ft; map says pads 9-11 are paved and wider.

Small inconsistency on the county pages: '3 days in advance' with example Friday -> Tuesday on L04, Friday -> Monday on C02. Reservation fee amount not stated. Website has two URLs in one field. Phone 319-636-2617 confirmed.
